label: New Mexico Wastewater Collection System Level 1 (CS1)
purpose: Practice questions for the New Mexico Wastewater Collection System Level 1 (CS1) written certification examination, technical outline only. Original items in US units. Not an official NMED examination or blueprint. Contains no population-band, certification-level, regulatory, permit, reporting, site-specific or emergency-response content.
reviewIntro: 250 original practice questions: 178 conceptual and 72 calculations, in US customary units. Scope is the technical content of the March 2026 CS1 Operator Guidebook as summarised in the readiness dossier. This is a local content package, not proof of a production import.
